title: Grid reveal
description: A wide picture is covered by a grid of tiles that fold away from the centre outwards (anime.js stagger with grid and from: 'center'); the title and caption come in under it. Every tile is gone at the end, so nothing stays on a face.

props.title: 2-6 words under the picture
props.caption: one or two lines
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 of the picture, if a person is in it
props.poster: still shown before a video loads

example.title: AI education for everyone
example.caption: The most beautiful way to learn AI.
